board1.lead: A speculative electric field robot that makes observation, branch-level tending, and energy service readable in one orchard rhythm.

cards.title: Canopy awareness
cards.body: A panoramic halo creates a clear visual relationship to the tree canopy.

cards.title: Gentle reach
cards.body: Two soft-tool arms focus attention on careful branch-level interaction.

cards.title: Field endurance
cards.body: Rear power drawers make service and electrical exchange visible as part of the system.

insights: Agricultural automation should remain legible to farm workers.
Outdoor equipment needs durable geometry and restrained visual complexity.
Field context should reinforce the product's low-impact care narrative.

modules.title: Panoramic sensor halo
modules.body: An upper sensing ring gives the product a clear observation identity.

modules.title: Soft-tool arm pair
modules.body: Two articulated arms communicate controlled reach without imitating human labor.

modules.title: Rear power drawers
modules.body: Serviceable energy modules support a readable field-maintenance scenario.

notes: All workflow and data elements are conceptual communication devices.
No agricultural yield, crop-health, or operational performance is asserted.
